spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/ledger-service/issues/31. Source revision: 2026-03-06T08:05:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Build and test on Java 21
tasks.body:
Set `maven.compiler.release` to 21 and upgrade Lombok, Mockito, JaCoCo, Surefire and Testcontainers to Java 21-compatible versions in the root `pom.xml`; switch `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to JDK 21.

## Acceptance criteria
- `mvn -B -ntp verify` passes on JDK 21 with no test changed or skipped.
- Versions are declared only in the root `pom.xml`.
- No application code changes.

tasks.title: Run the container on Java 21
tasks.body:
Move `ledger-app/Dockerfile` to eclipse-temurin:21-jre.

## Acceptance criteria
- The image builds and answers `/journals` on port 8080.
- The PR description gives payments the image tag to test.

tasks.title: Verify persistence on Java 21
tasks.body:
Run and fix the `ledger-persistence` integration tests on JDK 21 with the upgraded Testcontainers, without changing migrations or the PostgreSQL driver major version.

## Acceptance criteria
- `JdbcLedgerRepositoryIT` passes against PostgreSQL in Testcontainers on JDK 21.
- No migration file changes.

tasks.title: Make Posting a record
tasks.body:
Replace the Lombok `@Value` Posting with a Java record and update every accessor call in the same change.

## Acceptance criteria
- All callers use `account()`, `amount()` and `side()`.
- Balances and rounding are unchanged and all tests pass.
- JaCoCo line coverage of `ledger-core` does not drop.
